content:
While holding a conference about UFO sightings in 1966 over Hillsdale college J. Allen Hynek was given picture by newsman of photographed UFO and asked him what is this Hynek while holding picture he answered with straight face it was chicken feeder.  #UFOtwitter #UFOx

You can see how brainwashing of the people worked in the past. We know US and Russia took many scientists, engineers and prototypes of UFOs from Nazis in two separate operations called Paperclip and Osoviakhim.

That UFO on the picture he holds is long known as Haunebu Nazi Flying Saucer which could be flown by either American or Russian side.

If he was alive i would like to ask him why would decades later China and Japan patented electromagnetic craft which we know as Haunebu Nazi Flying Saucer if it was just chicken feeder.
